title: Contract Expiry Calendar for Small Business Electricity Supply: Notice Windows, Automatic Renewal and Rollover Plan
content:
The expiry calendar sets, for each Small Business Electricity Supply plan, the windows for the two expiration notices, the opt-out period, whether the term renews automatically and into which plan, the grace period after rollover, the rollover plan and the rate hold that follows late notices.

## Notice and election periods (calendar days)

| Plan | Initial renewal notice: earliest, before contract end | Initial renewal notice: latest, before contract end | Final options notice: latest, before contract end | Opt-out period after the final options notice | Grace period after rollover |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 15 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 15 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 15 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 15 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 15 |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | 90 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 15 |

## Renewal and rollover terms

| Plan | Renews automatically unless declined | Plan an automatic renewal renews into when the notice offers no other plan | Rollover plan | Rate hold after late notices |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | no | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 2 billing cycles |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | yes | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 2 billing cycles |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | yes | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 2 billing cycles |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | yes | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 2 billing cycles |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | yes | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 2 billing cycles |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | yes | Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | 2 billing cycles |

## Definitions

- **Initial renewal notice, earliest and latest:** the earliest and the latest point, in calendar days before contract end, for the initial renewal notice.
- **Final options notice, latest:** the latest point, in calendar days before contract end, for the final options notice.
- **Opt-out period:** the calendar days after the final options notice date within which the business may decline automatic renewal.
- **Grace period after rollover:** the calendar days after rollover during which an explicit renewal acceptance is still honoured.
- **Rollover plan:** the plan an expiring agreement converts to when it neither renews nor auto-renews.
- **Rate hold after late notices:** the billing cycles after rollover during which the expiring rate is held when notices were late.

## Worked calendar (hypothetical contract end date 31 December 2026)

| Calendar point | Date |
|---|---|
| 90 days before contract end | 2 October 2026 |
| 60 days before contract end | 1 November 2026 |
| 30 days before contract end | 1 December 2026 |

The 90-day and 60-day points are the earliest and the latest dates for the initial renewal notice; the 30-day point is the latest date for the final options notice.
